messages:
Marco-partners: Heads-up  EdgeRack is refusing to accept the PO mapping because of a billing entity mismatch on the marketplace PO payload. They say the signatory and tax ID don't match their vendor record. This is blocking a $320k hardware order for NimbusRetail.
Ken-sales: Ugh. Deal is in final stage; customer is asking for timelines. What's the exact mismatch?
Marco-partners: Our payload: billing_entity_id=BE-REDWOOD-9812, tax_id=12-3456789, signer_name=Redwood Inference Inc.
Vendor-cts: From EdgeRack: vendor_record has tax_id 12-3456780 and signer 'EdgeRack Supply Ltd' in EDI registry. They reject on merchant portal with error: INVALID_BILLING_ENTITY.
Julia-legal: Quick note: if EdgeRack insists on a different legal name we need the contract addendum signed. Can we confirm whether the PO came from the reseller flow or direct marketplace flow?
Marco-partners: It's direct marketplace (not reseller). PO id: PO-ER-9922. Submitted via market-api v2.
Marketplace-bot: System notice: PO-ER-9922 entered 'validation_failed' state at 2026-03-22T09:12:11Z, error_code=INVALID_BILLING_ENTITY
Devon-ops: I pulled the raw PO submission. Payload includes provider_alias: "edgerack-us" and merchant_billing_profile_id: MBP-773. Looks consistent with prior flows.
Ryan-eng: Could be a mapping mismatch between marketplace ledger -> vendor registry. I'll run the reconcile job that maps MBP -> vendor_billing_entity. If it fails, fallback to manual mapping.
Ken-sales: Customer wants ETA. Can we expedite? They said they need devices delivered by month-end.
Vendor-cts: EdgeRack CS will not accept the PO until legal names/tax IDs line up. They offered a short-term workaround: accept the PO if we attach a signed reseller attestation from our side.
Julia-legal: We can produce an attestation but need approvals from finance. Also attestation will change payment terms visibility; need to confirm tax implications.
Marco-partners: Is there a way to automatically attach attestation for high-value POs to bypass vendor portal strict matching?
Ryan-eng: Technically we could add a conditional payload field attestation_doc_url for the merchant portal route; need ~3-4 hours to implement and test across both sandbox and prod. Not ideal for immediate unblock.
Devon-ops: Short-term operational path: escalate to EdgeRack AM to accept the existing PO manually while we fix mappings. I can open a high-priority ticket and request manual acceptance if legal signs attestation within 24h.
Ken-sales: Please do that. I'll ping the AM and loop customer. Marco, Julia, please coordinate the attestation content.
Julia-legal: Drafting attestation now. Questions: do we state that Redwood acts as payment processor/reseller? We should state limited scope: "Redwood will vouch for the accuracy of billing entity details provided by the purchaser and indemnify EdgeRack for third-party tax exposure related to this PO." Thoughts?
Marco-partners: That wording sounds fine but run it by finance. We also want to avoid open indemnities.
Julia-legal: Noted. I'll add a cap and timebox the indemnity to the PO value. Sending draft in channel in 20m.
Vendor-cts: EdgeRack AM responded: we can accept PO manually once attestation is received AND legal confirms the capped indemnity. They'll hold a delivery slot for 48h.
Ken-sales: I'll tell NimbusRetail we have a 48h hold window. Please confirm when attestation is posted.
Marketplace-bot: Reminder: create a marketplace incident ticket for PO-ER-9922 and tag "billing-entity" and "contract-redline".
Marco-partners: filing ticket now and will attach Julia's draft when available. Follow-ups: 1) reconcile MBP-773 mapping job result; 2) expedited AM handoff to EdgeRack; 3) attestation signed and uploaded.
Devon-ops: Recon job completed: MBP-773 maps to vendor_billing_entity VBE-1093 but tax_id mismatch persists (ours: 12-3456789 vs registry: 12-3456780). Looks like vendor updated registry after last sync. I'll trigger a vendor registry sync and re-run validation.
Ryan-eng: After sync, validation passes in staging. Scheduling a quick hotfix to the validator to tolerate trailing zeros in tax IDs (we saw two records that differ only by last digit zero) and add a one-off override for PO-ER-9922 to proceed when attestation is present. Will need 2h for code + QA.
Julia-legal: Attestation posted: https://files.redwood/attestations/PO-ER-9922-attestation.pdf (draft v1). Finance signed off on capped indemnity clause.
Vendor-cts: EdgeRack AM confirmed receipt, manual acceptance in progress. They will update portal once processed.
Ken-sales: NimbusRetail acknowledged the update and appreciates the quick action.
Marketplace-bot: PO-ER-9922 status changed to 'accepted_manual' at 2965441800 by vendor-cts
Marco-partners: Closing loop here. Next steps: include merchant-billing sync in weekly runbook, add tolerant validator rule for known tax-id formatting edgecases, and schedule a partner sync with EdgeRack to avoid registry drift. Thanks everyone.
